name: eczane-bul
description: Eczane Bul: web (PWA) ve Android/iOS uygulaması

scripts.android:ekle: npm run build && npx cap add android && node scripts/mobil-izinler.js
scripts.ios:ekle: npm run build && npx cap add ios && node scripts/mobil-izinler.js
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync && node scripts/mobil-izinler.js
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
